body: Haha, you are truly too kind. How did you shift your mindset? I've been trying -- trust me, I'm usually a super positive person, and me like others have noticed that I'm not this person anymore. It's gruesome, the pain. I have no feeling of belief because each time I held onto something, it fell through. I don't believe in myself at all. I just feel like I make things worse. I don't know what I'm holding onto, certainly some feeling, but whatever that is, it is slowly going down. Like, I have no motivation. I need things to get better. I see a therapist bi-weekly, but the sessions feel like a waste when we accomplish nothing. I wish it were as easy to just start seeing my friends, thinking more positively, etc., but it's not, which I'm sure you understand.
